title: StepOutcome
description: One per step, ALWAYS written, never absent. A step can be satisfied or explained; it can never be silently abandoned.

status.description: There is no skip. deferred keeps the job open and the machine held; waived seals with a signed waiver and releases; impossible seals deficient and files a procedure defect.

reason_transcript.description: What the technician said, in their words.

reason_by.description: Named human, or the warrant_uid on the open tier.

recommendation_text.description: The Instructor's next action for the person standing there now.

disposition_action.description: The Foreman's call on what happens to the job, the machine, the booking and the parts order.

waived_by.description: Required when status is waived. A named person with the standing to waive.

provenance_class.description: A stated reason is always asserted — a named human said it, at this time.
